audit.why: 51.01% over 643 games. A snowball-or-lose lane: Pantheon has to bank everything before Kayle's form timers, and the page already frames it that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page puts Kayle's ranged form at level 11 and calls it her 'second form'. It also tells you to force the kill 'before 11'.
audit.why: Divine Ascent ascends at 6 (Arisen — she becomes ranged, +350 attack range for 525 total), 11 (Aflame — the fire waves) and 16 (Transcendent). So the moment she gets attack range is level 6, five levels earlier than the page says — and level 6 is also when Divine Judgment comes online. Telling a Pantheon he has until 11 to kill her hands her five free levels of ranged farming.
audit.corrected: Ranged form moved to level 6, the level-11 row relabelled to the Aflame wave spike, and the deadline in mid moved forward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Kayle ability is named anywhere on the page, and no cooldown appears at all — the packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Radiant Blast (Q) is her only skillshot: 900 range, 12/11/10/9/8s, and it slows AND shreds resistances, so it is the setup for everything she does — dodging it defuses the trade before it starts. Starfire Spellblade (E) is her auto-attack reset on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s. Divine Judgment (R) is 160s at rank 1, which is a full minute and a half of daylight after she burns it. Celestial Blessing (W) heals on a flat 15s. None of that was on the page.
audit.corrected: All five named, with Radiant Blast, Starfire Spellblade, Celestial Blessing and Divine Judgment cooldowns written into the text.

audit.why: Divine Judgment at 160s is the single longest cooldown in the matchup. Baiting it and then re-engaging inside that window is the whole plan after level 6, and the page instead treats her R as a permanent wall.
audit.corrected: The 160s number and the bait-then-re-engage pattern written into mid and whys[4].

audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals her on a flat 15s at every rank, which is what drags a losing trade back to even. Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades here.

edits.before: Kayle's level-11 second form gives her ranged autos and her real spike — her R invuln also blanks your full combo from here on.
edits.after: Level 6 Arisen is the real flip: she becomes ranged at 525 and Divine Judgment blanks your combo. Level 11 Aflame adds the fire waves.

edits.before: Survive to level 11 and her ranged second form, farming safe with melee-form autos
edits.after: Survive to level 6 Arisen and 525 attack range, farming safe with melee autos

edits.before: Hold her R invulnerability to negate your W-stun all-in and Grand Starfall dive
edits.after: Hold Divine Judgment to blank your Shield Vault all-in and Grand Starfall dive

edits.before: Use E's directional block to eat her ranged-form autos and walk her down under tower
edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at Radiant Blast, then walk her down before Arisen at level 6

edits.before: Kayle stabilizes and your raw kill pressure dips, and at 11 her ranged form is coming — she edges the lane as it approaches.
edits.after: Kayle stabilises and your kill pressure dips with level 6 Arisen one level away — she edges the lane as it approaches.

edits.before: Her R invulnerability blanks your full W-into-Q combo, so Grand Starfall is a roam tool here, not a 1v1 kill.
edits.after: Divine Judgment blanks your combo, but it is 160s at rank 1 — bait it, then the lane is yours again.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still own the lane: empowered-Q poke plus E to block her autos lets you keep her pinned under tower. But respect the clock — at 6 her R is just a panic button, yet her real timer is level 11 and her ranged second form. Once she hits it she gets auto range and her R invuln blanks your W-into-Q all-in entirely. Force the kill or burn her flash before 11; after that the lane inverts.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still own the lane: empowered Comet Spear plus Aegis Assault faced at Radiant Blast keeps her pinned under tower. Respect the real clock — level 6 is Arisen, where she becomes ranged at 525 and gets Divine Judgment. That is your deadline, not 11. Force the kill or her Flash before it. After 6, bait Divine Judgment and re-engage inside its 160s, and buy Grievous Wounds — Celestial Blessing heals every 15s.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a free beating if you press them. Pre-11 Kayle is a melee-range scaler with no dash and no waveclear — you W-stun in, Q-burst, and she has nothing to answer with but flash. Hold-and-aim your Q from max range to chunk her off the wave, and at level 2 (W+Q) go for the all-in the moment she steps up to last-hit. Every CS she misses and every recall you force here is permanent — she has no comeback button until 11.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are a free beating if you press them. Pre-6 Kayle is a melee scaler with no dash and no waveclear — Shield Vault in, empowered Comet Spear, and she has nothing but Flash. Dodge Radiant Blast: her only skillshot, 900 range on 12s at rank 1, and it shreds your resistances before she commits. At level 2 all-in the moment she steps up to last-hit. Every CS denied here is permanent — she has no button until 6.

edits.before: This is Kayle's game and you cannot fight it. In ranged form with Nashor's, Zhonya's and AS she kites your W-gap, shreds your squishy frame with on-hit, and R-invulns out of any all-in you start. Your job was to end it early — if you built a lead, splitpush and use Grand Starfall to take other lanes and objectives so the game closes before she takes over. Never 1v1 a fed Kayle past two items.
edits.after: This is Kayle's game and you cannot fight it. Aflame at 11 and Transcendent at 16 stack onto Nashor's and Zhonya's: she kites Shield Vault's 600, resets autos with Starfire Spellblade, and Divine Judgment blanks any all-in you start. Your job was to end it early — with a lead, splitpush and use Grand Starfall on other lanes and objectives so the game closes first. Never 1v1 a fed Kayle past two items.

notes: REAL ERROR, ASSERTED FIVE TIMES: the page had Kayle going ranged at level 11 and told the player he had until 11 to kill her. Divine Ascent ascends at 6 (Arisen — becomes ranged, +350 attack range for 525 total), 11 (Aflame — fire waves) and 16 (Transcendent). The kit file only says she gains range 'progressively' and gives no levels, so I confirmed the breakpoints on the League Wiki. This is the one matchup in my slice where I went to the web, and it was worth it: the old text handed Kayle five free levels. Also fixed the packet defect that the page never named a Kayle ability and had zero sequencing cues — Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing, Starfire Spellblade and Divine Judgment are now named with cooldowns. Divine Judgment at 160s at rank 1 is the biggest punishable window in the lane and was previously written as an unconditional wall.
